lessons_learned.primary_finding: Backtest Result Contract v1.0 audit_bt_result must validate frequency-vs-data-cadence consistency. Currently audit passes if 'frequency' field is set, regardless of actual data spacing. Frequency mislabel (declared 'daily' on bi-monthly inner-join 138-obs series) inflates Sharpe by sqrt(252/12)=4.58x and CAGR exponentially.
lessons_learned.secondary_finding: Inner-join blending of two strategies with different rebalance schedules is mathematically equivalent to sub-sampling. Blend operations across strategies with different schedules require explicit forward-fill to common grid OR explicit relabeling to LCM frequency.
lessons_learned.tertiary_finding: Defense alpha at SIGNAL level (AX-001 v2 axis 1 + 3 PASS) ≠ defense alpha at PORTFOLIO level (top-20 long-only HRP carries +60% MKT beta + +56% LVOL). The signal-vs-portfolio honesty gap is the structural AX-007 concern. Multi-sleeve blend is mandatory but must use proper monthly grid.
lessons_learned.quaternary_finding: Plain Harvey t-stat = 5.475 inflates by serial correlation; HAC-corrected NW t (forge realized) = 0.29-1.29 across 5 specs. Statistical defense Gate (Harvey 2016 t > 3.0) FAILS independent of fabrication. Alpha-side 'estimated NW t 4.2-5.0' (CF-06) was unverified self-assertion.
lessons_learned.proposed_l_code_text: Backtest Result Contract v1.0 audit_bt_result must validate frequency-vs-cadence consistency (median(diff(date)) vs declared annualization_factor). Frequency mislabel inflates Sharpe by sqrt(N_declared/N_actual). Charter v1.5 §13 enhancement: blend operations across strategies with different rebalance schedules require explicit forward-fill to common grid OR explicit relabeling to LCM frequency. Pattern: bi-monthly inner-join + 'daily' annotation = AX-002 fabrication. WT-D20260429_001 Defense factor blend exemplar (06_metrics.csv Sharpe 8.22 / CAGR 799% / Sortino 18.37 / Calmar 4049). Companion finding: Plain Harvey t inflates vs HAC-corrected NW (Defense alpha plain t=5.475 → HAC t_nw 0.29-1.29 across 5 specs).
